artworks.title: Landscape with Horses
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 12.7 x 20.32 cm (5 x 8 in.)
sheet: 20.32 x 30.48 cm (8 x 12 in.)
artworks.description: The etching features a low-angle perspective of a rural scene. The horizon is depicted above center, showing a line of trees and buildings. In the background are houses with stonework, thatched roofs, trees, and fences. The scene is created using cross-hatched and parallel lines for texture and depth. The color scheme is monochromatic with various shades of brown. The foreground includes grass, weeds, and a path leading to two grazing horses in the distance. A man on a ladder against a pole is seen to the right, adding a human element. Swirling lines in the sky imply movement in the clouds.

artworks.title: Nursemaid and Child
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person reclining in a pastoral landscape. The image shows a serene outdoor setting where a person is lying on the grass, covered with a patterned blanket or piece of fabric, near a rocky outcrop or hill. The background includes a gently sloping field with rows, suggesting plowed land or textured grass, leading to a small group of grazing animals, potentially cows, in the distance. The linework is delicate, with a sketch-like quality providing texture to the grassy foreground and the foliage of a cluster of trees to the left. The overall mood conveys tranquility and a connection to nature, with details highlighting the contours of the landscape and the intricacy of the figure's attire.

artworks.title: Thames Warehouses
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor scene with detailed etching style. Large multi-masted ships are docked along the water's edge, with tall masts. The view is from a slightly elevated angle, showing small boats on the water and figures engaging in activities. Buildings line the waterfront, with signs indicating businesses like "Rope & Sail Makers" and "Hermitage Coal and Wine." Smokestacks release smoke into the sky on the right side. The overall color palette is in sepia tones.

artworks.title: Old Westminster Bridge
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 7.62 x 20.32 cm (3 x 8 in.)
sheet: 10.16 x 22.86 cm (4 x 9 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a river with a bridge and buildings along the horizon. The brushstrokes are detailed, particularly in depicting the bridge and buildings. The style uses a monochromatic palette of black and white. Two figures on horseback are near the water's edge, interacting with a small boat. The river has sailboats and other small vessels, leading towards the distant bridge. The background includes a cityscape with buildings and trees.

artworks.title: Limehouse
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 12.7 x 20.32 cm (5 x 8 in.)
sheet: 15.24 x 22.86 cm (6 x 9 in.)
artworks.description: The etching depicts a bustling dock scene from a slightly elevated angle. The horizon is low in the composition, with ship masts extending upward towards the sky. The artwork features fine, detailed lines with cross-hatching for texture. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown to emphasize details of the docks and ships. Wooden boats are tethered to a pier with figures, and more ships are visible in the distance. The scene conveys activity and movement typical of a busy maritime setting.

artworks.title: Eagle Wharf
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a port area with a seated figure near the water's edge. Boats are docked to the left, with buildings displaying signs like "F. Izac Whiteley & Co." There are distant silhouettes of masts and ships, suggesting the horizon. The artwork is detailed with sketch-like etching lines defining structures, water, and elements. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown and black. The scene captures a working dock with rich textures and contrast, conveying a sense of stillness and industry.

artworks.title: The Pool
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This image shows a riverside view looking towards a harbor area. The perspective is from the waterline, with a man in a boat closest to the viewer. The horizon is above the boats, aligning with the cityscape and ship masts in the distance. The artwork appears to be an etching, featuring detailed linework creating textures. The composition is primarily uncolored with sepia tones. The scene includes a dock, small boats with goods or nets, a busy dockside, and various buildings in the background, indicating a bustling setting.

artworks.title: Thames Police
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black
artworks.description: The image depicts a busy wharf from a slightly elevated perspective, showing activity on the dock and structures along the riverside. The horizon is formed by a line of buildings with smokestacks, and the scene is detailed in an etching technique with fine lines and hatching. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of sepia. Several boats are moored with people in 19th-century clothing, and more ships with masts can be seen along the water. In the background, there are brick and wooden buildings, some labeled with signs like "Thames Police" and "Wapping Wharf." The sky is detailed with light strokes, possibly suggesting movement or light cloud cover.

artworks.title: Thames Police
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed riverside scene with activity along the waterway and surrounding architecture. The horizon is defined by buildings on the right and ship masts on the left. The scene is rendered in fine etching strokes with a sepia color palette. Closest to the viewer are boats with people engaging in dockside activities. The river is occupied by tall-masted ships, and the skyline is defined by an urban landscape with visible signage.

artworks.title: Longshoremen
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on green laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 15.24 x 22.86 cm (6 x 9 in.)
sheet: 22.86 x 30.48 cm (9 x 12 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with various objects and seated figures. The drawing shows individuals in a close space, possibly a tavern or pub, with a mug on a table. The scene is illustrated with detailed line work, including cross-hatching for depth and shadow on the figures' attire and expressions. The setting features wooden furniture, suggesting a rustic atmosphere. Line variation adds texture and movement to elements like clothing. The style and composition resemble etchings of social gatherings.

artworks.title: The Lime-Burner
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on possibly laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rustic building's interior with various tools. The artwork depicts a structure that appears to be a barn or shed, filled with wooden beams and supports, ladders leaning against the wall, and an assortment of farming tools scattered around. A pathway leads into the interior, where light enters through the open entrance, revealing more of the tools and objects within.

artworks.title: Soupe à Trois Sous (Soup for three sous [pennies])
artworks.medium: etching on Japanese laid paper
artworks.description: Five individuals are depicted in the image, seated at tables. The person on the far left stands beside a doorway, leaning forward with arms crossed on a table. This person has long, wavy hair and a bearded face. The next person, seated with head bent down, wears a cap and a jacket. Moving to the right, there are two individuals seated together; one leans back with a hat obscuring much of the face, while the other leans forward resting on an arm. On the far right, a person wearing a large brimmed hat sits with hands on the table, with facial features obscured. The individuals' clothing appears to be from an earlier era, with jackets, hats, and long sleeves. On the tables, there are various objects including bottles, cups, and a tray with plates. The scene is sketched in a simple, linear manner with minimal background detail and a faint signature to the right of the central figure.

artworks.title: Bibi Lalouette
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The etching depicts a person in half-length side profile, seated with their body slightly turned away. The person has a curly hairstyle framing their face, a defined nose, and a slightly visible mouth. They wear a loose garment with billowy sleeves. Near their knee is a rectangular case or book. The background is simple. In the lower right side, there is a signature that reads "Whistler" and the date "1859."

artworks.title: Becquet
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The portrait depicts the upper half of a man's body. He is seated, facing the viewer with a direct gaze. The man has a pronounced mustache and goatee, along with thick, curly hair. He wears a long-sleeved garment and a wide-brimmed hat. His left arm is bent, holding what appears to be the neck of a stringed musical instrument, likely a cello. The background consists of crosshatched lines, adding depth and texture to the image. The drawing style is sketchy, with finer strokes used for the man's facial features and hair, while the clothing and background are more abstract.

artworks.title: Becquet
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on Asian laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a man seated in a relaxed position from the thigh up. The man has intense eyes, a prominent nose, and a mustache paired with a full beard. He has voluminous, curly hair under a loosely fitting hat while wearing a long coat. He holds a cello upright as it rests against his leg, but there is no bow present. The backdrop is filled with sketchy lines, likely representing texture.

artworks.title: Z. Astruc, Editor of _L'Artiste_
artworks.medium: drypoint on Asian laid paper
artworks.description: The sketch depicts the upper half of a man's body. He is seated facing slightly to his right, with a full beard and thick, slightly tousled hair. His facial features are detailed with bold lines, showing deep-set eyes and a strong brow. He appears to be wearing a jacket over a collared shirt, with one hand raised and resting against his chest or collar area. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is minimal, with abstract lines and shading for slight depth. The artist's signature, "Whistler 49", is in the lower left corner.

artworks.title: Venus
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying on their side. They are reclined against draped fabric or pillows. The person has long, wavy hair and closed eyes. They are unclothed, with draped fabric around them. The background is loosely sketched with additional fabric and drapery. The image is rendered in a monochromatic tone with shading techniques emphasizing the figure and textiles.

artworks.title: Venus
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying down on their stomach, head turned slightly to the side, left arm resting alongside their body, right hand held near their face. The person's eyes appear closed, with textured, curly hair cascading around their face and shoulder. The person appears unclothed, with shading accentuating their body's contours. The background is a sketchy, textured surface indicating a bed or fabric pile, with diagonal lines behind the person hinting at depth or drapery. In the bottom left corner, there is a signature "Whistler" and a date "1859."

artworks.title: Isle de la Cité, Paris
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a bird's-eye view sketch of a cityscape with two bridges crossing over a river. One bridge is closer, has an iron lattice structure and several pedestrian figures. The other bridge is larger, made of stone with multiple arches, connecting to a small island with clustered buildings. Trees are lightly sketched, and the background fades into less defined structures. The artist uses fine, precise lines to depict architectural elements, creating a dynamic atmosphere. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing contrast through varied densities of ink lines, offering a sharp impression of the historical urban setting.

artworks.title: Annie Haden
artworks.medium: drypoint in dark brown on Asian laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length view of a person depicted in a sketch. The person stands upright, facing slightly towards the viewer's left. They have long hair flowing down over their shoulders and wear a round, flat hat. The person's clothing consists of a long cape that drapes down from their shoulders and a full, long skirt. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects being held by the person. The background features primarily vertical lines, suggesting drapery or a curtain-like setting, giving an impression of a neutral or minimalistic indoor environment.

artworks.title: Mr. Davis (Mr. Mann)
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing the upper half of a seated person. The person is reclined slightly with their right arm resting on a surface and their left arm crossed over their body. They have a full face with a contemplative expression, short dark hair, facial hair around the cheeks and chin, a broad-brimmed hat, and a voluminous coat or cape on their shoulders. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects. The background features abstract textures resembling a corner of a room with horizontal and vertical lines. In the bottom left corner, the artist's signature "Whistler" and the date "1859" are visible.

artworks.title: Rotherhithe
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on Asian laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a harbor scene. The image depicts tall sailing vessels with intricate masts and rigging in the background. In the foreground, there is an architectural structure or a tall building. The drawing is executed with fine lines and cross-hatching, providing texture to the waves in the water and the clouds in the sky. Small boats are scattered across the water.

artworks.title: The Penny Boat
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 8.57 x 20.64 cm (3 3/8 x 8 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a harbor scene with a crowd of people in the foreground, boats and ships on the water, and buildings lining the horizon. The drawing uses monochromatic colors and intricate linework to show light and shadow, creating a sepia-toned effect.

artworks.title: The Forge
artworks.medium: drypoint on Asian laid
artworks.description: The image is a black and white sketch showing a group of people inside a space. The sketch displays parts of several figures' bodies, including a man in the foreground with his torso and upper body visible, wearing a hat, long clothes, and holding a tool in his left hand. To his right, two other individuals, likely males, are depicted from the waist up, wearing hats, long shirts, and holding tools. In the background, there are faint figures that may represent more people, some with hooded or shawl-like garments. On the right side, parts of their bodies are visible as they sit or stand near a wooden structure. The background features vertical lines, possibly representing wooden walls with hanging tools, suggesting a workshop or rustic living area.
